fr_html: M. ADATCI demande à Lord Phillimore si ce sera le rapport définitif et le texte adopté en seconde lecture qui seront présentés au Conseil.
en_html: M. ADATCI asked Lord Phillimore, whether it was to be the final report and the text as adopted at the second reading which were to be submitted to the Council.
